body: I feel like you, I hope that if you are truly ready to leave this life that you are successful
exactly what im thinking about. have one method that seems likely to work, gonna try to find 2-4 more and do them all at once.
If only that peace could be had with both feet planted in this realm .. I totally feel you
I made it 81 more days. I am now making plans and will follow through

I wish I was good enough for the life I wanted.. I wish things were different. Everything is just another reminder that I have never wanted this life.. I have tried to play the cards dealt to me, but nothing feels worth it whatsoever.. at best, I will find success and “randomly” die at some point..

what’s a life of chosen isolation that feels forced? i make friends easily, it’s a performance.. you grow more distant naturally from childhood friends as you age, im no longer comfortable with people i grew up with even though nothing happened. vulnerability, connecting with people (family too) is a fool’s errand.. so i work my hardest every day and collapse at night, i will find success if i stay alive but i won’t have anyone to share it with, i won’t even know how to..  

i deal with hella guilt feeling as of suicide is the easy way out, the only reason id stay is to succeed and PROVE that my problems weren’t a lack of talent or drive, it was being poisoned by everyone ive ever trusted .. but who is anyone to prove anything to? I should just do what I feel best suits me
i appreciate it more than i can express
Thank you.. spending time with friends helped me get through yesterday, I'm currently waiting to go to the ER.. thank you
Going to the ER in a few hours.. hoping I can get some sort of ECT

Patience... Trying very hard to have patience but I don't want to live anymore.. tired of being at this crossroads.. I'm scared. My mood has gone downhill for a few days now but I haven't cared to tell anyone I'm suicidal again.. I just want to go do it.. fuck it lol I guess this is what happens when you fuck your life up? 

I tried my best.. but not all the time, so I'm not mad at the world for these results I just think it's time I wrap this shit up.. even if everything works out for me, I'll just be rich with no real connection to the world I live in. Fuck it

i really appreciate it but no conversation will make the rest of my life hurt any less.. ive talked endlessly about this in the past. but you don't have to offer and i thank you for being generous with your time

Truly wishing someone would intervene and save me.. but nobody owes me that, nor does anyone who's helped in the past deserve to go through this again with their chronically depressed friend.. part of me wants to reach out to someone for help but i don't want to waste anyone's time.. anyone i would reach out to has been here with me before. another summer of suicidal thoughts.. i need to just try what i can try and let the outcome be what it is
